name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-link
title: Super Mario World Styled Link
description:
I've had this nearly done for quite awhile, but only just finished it now. Thanks to andy_k_250 for the tilemap patch, and Ladida for helping me with removing the cape tilemap. Also, Fire Green Link and Red Link look the same.



Note: The cape is...weird. I decided to try making custom cape flying tilemaps, and turning them into the Deku Leaf. They don't exactly look bad, but they look kinda wonky. You are free to alter things however you like.
Updated to actually have the .asm files this time, cause I'm dumb and forgot.
